title: Ezekiel 44
paragraphs: ¹ Then he brought me back to the outer gate of the sanctuary facing east, and it was shut. ² The LORD said to me, "This gate is to remain shut. It must not be opened; no one may enter through it. It is to remain shut because the LORD, the God of Israel, has entered through it. ³ The prince himself is the only one who may sit in the gateway to eat in the presence of the LORD. He is to enter by way of the portico of the gateway and go out the same way." ⁴ Then he brought me by way of the north gate to the front of the temple. I looked, and the glory of the LORD filled the temple, and I fell facedown. ⁵ The LORD said to me, "Son of man, pay close attention and look carefully and listen closely to everything I tell you concerning all the regulations and instructions regarding the temple of the LORD. Pay close attention to the entrance of the temple and all the exits of the sanctuary.

⁶ Say to the rebellious house of Israel: This is what the Lord GOD says: Enough of your detestable practices, house of Israel! ⁷ When you brought in foreigners — uncircumcised in heart and uncircumcised in body — to be in my sanctuary, you desecrated it. While you were offering me food, fat, and blood, they broke my covenant with all your detestable practices. ⁸ Instead of carrying out your duty regarding my holy things, you appointed them to keep charge of my sanctuary for you. ⁹ This is what the Lord GOD says: No foreigner, uncircumcised in heart and body, shall enter my sanctuary — not even the foreigners who live among the Israelites. ¹⁰ As for the Levites who went far from me when Israel went astray, straying after their idols, they must bear the consequences of their sin.

¹¹ They may serve in my sanctuary as gatekeepers and as workers in the temple. They may slaughter the burnt offerings and other sacrifices for the people and stand before the people to serve them. ¹² But because they served the people before their idols and became a stumbling block of iniquity to the house of Israel, therefore I swore against them with an uplifted hand, declares the Lord GOD, and they must bear the consequences of their sin. ¹³ They shall not approach me to serve as priests or come near any of my holy things or my most holy offerings. They must bear their shame and the consequences of the detestable things they have done. ¹⁴ Yet I will appoint them to guard the temple and carry out all its maintenance and all the work that is to be done in it. ¹⁵ But the Levitical priests, who are descendants of Zadok and who guarded my sanctuary when the Israelites went astray from me, shall come near to minister before me. They shall stand in my presence to offer me fat and blood, declares the Lord GOD.

¹⁶ They are the ones who shall enter my sanctuary and come near to my table to minister before me. They shall keep my charge. ¹⁷ When they enter the gates of the inner court, they shall wear linen garments. They shall wear no wool while ministering at the gates of the inner court or inside it. ¹⁸ They shall wear linen turbans on their heads and linen undergarments around their waists. They shall not wear anything that causes sweat. ¹⁹ When they go out into the outer court to the people, they shall take off the garments in which they were ministering and leave them in the holy rooms. Then they shall put on other clothes so they do not consecrate the people by means of their garments. ²⁰ They shall not shave their heads or let their hair grow long, but shall keep their hair trimmed.

²¹ No priest shall drink wine before entering the inner court. ²² They shall not marry widows or divorced women; they may only marry virgins from the Israelite community or widows of priests. ²³ They shall teach my people the difference between the holy and the common, and show them how to distinguish between the unclean and the clean. ²⁴ When there is a dispute, they shall serve as judges and decide it according to my ordinances. They shall keep my laws and my statutes regarding all my appointed feasts, and they shall keep my Sabbaths holy. ²⁵ A priest shall not make himself ceremonially unclean by going near a dead person. However, he may defile himself for a father, mother, son, daughter, brother, or an unmarried sister.

²⁶ After a priest is cleansed, he must wait seven more days. ²⁷ On the day he enters the inner court of the sanctuary to minister there, he shall offer a sin offering for himself, declares the Lord GOD. ²⁸ The priests shall have no land of their own in Israel — I am their inheritance. You are not to give them any property in Israel; I am their possession. ²⁹ They shall eat the grain offerings, the sin offerings, and the guilt offerings. Everything devoted to God in Israel will belong to them. ³⁰ The first of all the firstfruits and all the special contributions of every kind shall belong to the priests. You shall also give the priests the first portion of your ground grain, so that a blessing may rest on your household.
³¹ The priests shall not eat anything — whether bird or animal — that has died naturally or been torn by wild animals.
